S-waves do not travel through liquid.

items: Seismic wave properties are heavily tested: S-waves cannot pass through liquids, proving the outer core is liquid.
Moho discontinuity specifically separates the crust from the mantle.
Remember NIFE stands for Nickel (Ni) and Iron (Fe) when asked about core composition.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: S-waves are seismic waves that cannot travel through liquid layers.
The mantle constitutes the thickest structural layer of the Earth.
The core's chemical composition is mainly Nickel and Iron (NIFE).
The Mohorovičić (Moho) discontinuity separates the Earth's crust and mantle.
The asthenosphere provides the fluid-like layer that enables plate tectonics.
Convection currents in the outer core generate Earth's magnetic field.
